$comment: Selected engine-curve points and POH cruise/glide values as cited facts; not a copy of any chart or table and not a flight model. Field guide: README.md in this directory. Schema: data/schema/performance-values.schema.json.
extraction: User decision 2026-11-01 18:43 (GAPS Q5): extract only the needed points of the Lycoming IO-360-L2A power curve as cited facts, never the whole chart; the no-piecemeal rule of the POH extraction applies. POH cruise and glide values follow the user decision 2026-11-01 13:59. Purpose: calibration of a JSBSim piston engine and airframe in the circuit regime (research note docs/research/2026-11-01-c172s-poh-values.md). Chart points were read on page images rendered at 400 dpi.

citations.section: Section 2 Specifications, IO-360-L2A block and its footnote; no revision mark on page

rated_power_normal.conversion: hp x 745.69987158227022 W (mechanical horsepower), rounded to 0.1 W
rated_power_normal.uncertainty: As published; uninstalled engine. The 172S uses the alternate rating (manifest engine.ratings).

citations.section: Section 2 Specifications, IO-360-L2A block and its footnote; no revision mark on page

rated_speed_normal.conversion: rpm x 2 pi / 60, rounded to 4 decimals

rated_power_alternate.condition: IO-360-L2A alternate rating, at 2700 rpm (footnote); the rating used by the 172S

citations.section: Section 2 Specifications, IO-360-L2A block and its footnote; no revision mark on page

rated_power_alternate.conversion: hp x 745.69987158227022 W (mechanical horsepower), rounded to 0.1 W
rated_power_alternate.uncertainty: As published; agrees with S9 (134 kW, 180 HP at 2700 rpm, alternate rating) and with the manifest rated_power.

citations.section: Section 2 Specifications, IO-360-L2A block and its footnote; no revision mark on page

rated_speed_alternate.conversion: rpm x 2 pi / 60, rounded to 4 decimals
rated_speed_alternate.uncertainty: As published; agrees with the 172S TCDS maximum rpm in the manifest.

citations.section: Section 2 Specifications, IO-360-L2A block and its footnote; no revision mark on page

displacement.conversion: in^3 x 1.6387064e-5 m^3 (exact), rounded to 5 significant digits

full_throttle.condition: Uninstalled engine, sea-level standard temperature and pressure, maximum-power mixture, fuel minimum grade 91/96; point at the upper (full-throttle) end of each drawn sea-level curve. The chart is drawn for the 160 hp / 2400 rpm rating; curves for 2500-2700 rpm are dashed, and the chart legend read does not state what the dashing means.

citations.section: Section 3, Figure 3-25 Sea Level and Altitude Performance IO-360-L2A, curve no. 13516-A, sea-level panel; no revision mark on page

full_throttle.selection: Curve ends at 2000, 2400, 2500 and 2700 rpm: lower circuit power, the normal rating (check against p. 2-2), and the 2500-2700 rpm range of the 172S alternate rating. 4 of the 8 drawn curves; other curves not read.
full_throttle.conversion: rpm x 2 pi / 60 (4 decimals); inHg x 3386.389 Pa (conventional inch of mercury, NIST SP 811; 0.1 Pa); hp x 745.69987158227022 W (0.1 W)
full_throttle.uncertainty: Read off a scanned chart with pixel interpolation between grid lines (5 hp, 1 inHg); power +/-2 hp and manifold pressure +/-0.1 inHg, except 2500 rpm (curve ends in a short dash) +/-3 hp. The 2700 rpm curve ends at a small circle on the 180 hp grid line, whose top grid row is drawn wider than the others. Uninstalled-engine data: installation (induction, exhaust, cooling) losses and the fixed-pitch propeller's rpm limits are not included. Cross-check: altitude-panel sea-level intercepts agree within 1.5 hp (research note).

citations.section: Section 3, Figure 3-25 Sea Level and Altitude Performance IO-360-L2A, curve no. 13516-A, sea-level panel; no revision mark on page

full_throttle_2300_rpm.uncertainty: The chart has no 2300 rpm curve (curves at 1600, 1800, 2000, 2200, 2400, 2500, 2600, 2700 rpm).
full_throttle_2300_rpm.todo: Decide in the engine model whether to interpolate between the 2200 and 2400 rpm curves (a derived value with its method) instead of reading a value the chart does not draw.

part_throttle.condition: Uninstalled engine, sea-level standard temperature and pressure, maximum-power mixture; power on the sea-level curve at the given absolute manifold pressure

citations.section: Section 3, Figure 3-25 Sea Level and Altitude Performance IO-360-L2A, curve no. 13516-A, sea-level panel; no revision mark on page

part_throttle.selection: Three part-throttle points on curves traced without ambiguity: 2000 rpm at 20 and 24 inHg (approach/descent region) and 2400 rpm at 26 inHg (cruise/downwind region). The 2400 rpm curve is not read near 24 inHg, where its label and the chart's worked-example marks cover it.
part_throttle.conversion: rpm x 2 pi / 60 (4 decimals); inHg x 3386.389 Pa (conventional inch of mercury, NIST SP 811; 0.1 Pa); hp x 745.69987158227022 W (0.1 W)
part_throttle.uncertainty: Read off a scanned chart with pixel interpolation; manifold pressure taken exactly on the inHg grid line, power +/-2 hp. Uninstalled-engine data as for full_throttle.

pa_2000ft_standard_temperature.condition: 2550 lb; recommended lean mixture at all altitudes (POH Section 4, cruise); pressure altitude 2000 ft; standard temperature column. Percent BHP as printed; the power it refers to is not stated on the page.

citations.section: Section 5, Figure 5-8 sheet 1 of 2, cruise performance; page mark July 8/98

pa_2000ft_standard_temperature.selection: All six rpm rows of the 2000 ft block (2100-2550 rpm), standard-temperature column only: the pressure altitude closest to the EDFE circuit; the two non-standard temperature columns and other altitudes are not extracted.
pa_2000ft_standard_temperature.conversion: rpm x 2 pi / 60 (4 decimals); percent / 100 (4 decimals); kt x 1852/3600 m/s (4 decimals); US gal/h x 3.785411784e-3 m^3 / 3600 s, rounded to 5 significant digits
pa_2000ft_standard_temperature.uncertainty: Tabulated to 1 %, 1 kt and 0.1 gal/h; no tolerance stated. POH performance data assume an airplane and engine in good condition and average piloting technique (p. 5-3).

best_glide_ias.condition: Maximum glide speed; no weight stated

citations.section: Section 3, airspeeds for emergency operation; page mark May 30/00
Section 3, Figure 3-1 Maximum Glide, conditions box; page mark Revision 4

best_glide_ias.conversion: kt x 1852/3600 m/s, rounded to 4 decimals
best_glide_ias.uncertainty: As published; no weight dependence given in this POH revision.

distance_12000ft.condition: Maximum glide: ground distance from 12,000 ft height above terrain; 68 KIAS, propeller windmilling, flaps up, zero wind; no weight stated

citations.section: Section 3, Figure 3-1 Maximum Glide; page mark Revision 4

distance_12000ft.uncertainty: Read off the chart line (a double stroke; centre used) where it meets the 12,000 ft top border: 17.97 nm, recorded as 18.0 +/-0.2 nm. The line passes through the origin.

citations.section: Section 3, Figure 3-1 Maximum Glide; page mark Revision 4

glide_ratio.derivation: distance_12000ft / height: 18.0 nm x 1852 m / (12000 ft x 0.3048 m) = 9.1142; the chart line is straight through the origin, so the ratio holds for every height on it.
glide_ratio.uncertainty: +/-0.1 from the distance reading; still-air ground distance over height, so equal to the lift-to-drag ratio only approximately.

not_extracted.item: Lycoming Figure 3-25: the 1600, 1800, 2200 and 2600 rpm sea-level curves, the rest of the curves read, the altitude panel and the temperature-correction formula
not_extracted.reason: Not needed for the circuit-regime calibration; whole-chart digitisation is excluded by the user decision of 2026-11-01 18:43. Altitude-panel readings appear only as a cross-check in the research note.

not_extracted.item: Lycoming part-throttle fuel consumption (Figure 3-9) and the operating-conditions table (75 %/65 % cruise for the 160 hp rating)
not_extracted.reason: Fuel flow is taken from the POH cruise table of the installed engine; the table is for the 160 hp rating, not the 172S alternate rating.

not_extracted.item: POH cruise table: 20 deg C below/above standard columns, other pressure altitudes (Figure 5-8 sheets 1 and 2), range and endurance profiles (Figures 5-9, 5-10)
not_extracted.reason: Not needed for circuit-regime calibration; only the block nearest the circuit altitude at standard temperature.

not_extracted.item: POH glide chart at other heights
not_extracted.reason: The chart line is straight through the origin; one reading and the derived ratio carry it, so further points add nothing.
